mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.2% in a month coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.22.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index above the prior month's level signals wage growth, which is associated with higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In 100 triggered months, 20-day forward returns are negative or flat, with no significant correlation to PAYEMS changes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in HOUST industrial production below the prior month's level indicates weakening demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 200 such contractions, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO supply index below 100 signals supply-side weakness, which is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: More than 40% of INDPRO < 100 events yield non-negative 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a month, the 60-day S&P 500 forward return tends to be negative as higher rates discount future equity values.
failure_condition: In 50 such hike events, 60-day forward returns are not consistently negative (median > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly UNRATE declines of at least 0.1 percentage points predict a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market softness supports rate cut expectations.
failure_condition: Over 30 such UNRATE declines, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 2% in the same month triggers a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return via risk-off reversal.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < GDPC1 previous month - 2 AND RSAFS < RSAFS previous month - 2
failure_condition: In 50 such dual shocks, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (median ≤ 0).

mechanism_narrative: When supply (INDPRO) remains flat for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is more likely to be positive due to reduced supply-side constraints.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO == INDPRO previous month AND INDPRO == INDPRO two_months_ago
failure_condition: Over 100 such flat months, 60-day forward returns are not higher than average baseline (p > 0.05).
